ideas.title: Following the Money in Child Care Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the financial trail of child care fraud in Minnesota and potentially other states
questions: How much money has been lost to child care fraud in Minnesota?
What are the most common schemes used to commit child care fraud?
ideas.insight: By following the money, we can uncover the scope of child care fraud and potentially identify key players and schemes

ideas.title: ICE Under Scrutiny
ideas.description: Investigate the recent controversies surrounding ICE, including the shooting of Silverio Villegas-Gonzalez
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the shooting of Silverio Villegas-Gonzalez?
How has ICE responded to the shooting and subsequent controversy?
ideas.insight: By investigating ICE's activities and responses to controversy, we can shed light on the agency's practices and potentially identify areas for reform
